name: Mike Braaten

nadir.desc: The property consists of a two-story white residence with a gray roof|A large gravel and dirt parking area surrounds the structure and holds multiple vehicles|Wooden stairs and a deck are attached to one side of the building|Open ground, trees, and outdoor items are present around the lot|The property is located in a semi-rural setting.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a two-story white structure with a gray roof|A large gravel parking area holds multiple vehicles|Wooden stairs lead to an upper-level entry or deck|Outdoor storage items and bins are present near the building|Trees frame portions of the front and sides.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side elevation of the white structure with an elevated deck or balcony area|Vehicles and outdoor equipment are parked on the gravel surface|Trees and open ground surround this side of the property.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back elevation of the two-story structure|A gravel surface and open ground extend behind the building|Trees and outdoor items are present|Portions of the roof and upper level are visible.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side of the white structure and the large gravel parking area|Multiple vehicles are parked near the building|Trees and open ground continue around this side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a gravel driveway and large open parking area that leads from the road to the residence. The front and sides of the property are open and offer substantial space for emergency vehicle staging. Multiple vehicles currently occupy portions of the parking area. Trees surround parts of the lot but do not fully enclose the structure. The property has a semi-rural layout with good overall access from the street.
